title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 bootstrap launch input of the OpenAI Codex CLI engine (relaunch plan v2.7 §7 bootstrap launches and launch qualification, §14 B-0c / B-1)
description: A bootstrap launch input with "engine": "codex": everything bootstrap_launch_input.json requires of a Claude Code launch except its Claude-only fields (claude_bin, claude_min_version, permission_mode, max_turns, mcp_config, mcp_config_sha256, extra_lean_flags, disallowed_tools — any of them refuses), plus codex_bin, codex_min_version, sandbox, network, writable_dirs and, optionally: output_schema with output_schema_sha256; work_root ("job" for a reviewer) with item_worktree. Shape only. Not checked by this schema, and checked by fleet/kyboot.py check before any launch: every rule listed for a Claude launch input that applies (manifest and supervisor first; paths; worktree and branch policy; hashes; card and packet in the prompt; scratch and state locations; environment allowlist; effort per kind; deadline; card_path and output_schema as manifest components; the item lock) and, for Codex: writable dirs exist; read-only has none and no network; no writable root holds or lies in the worktree's common git directory; a builder says commit_mode "launcher" and network false, and its result.json is a job_result_launcher_commit document; the receipt <role>-<model> says engine codex and binds program path, sha256 and version, model, effort, sandbox, network, writable_dirs, disabled features, --ignore-user-config / --ignore-rules, output schema hash, AGENTS.md / ~/.codex/AGENTS.md / ~/.codex/hooks.json hashes, environment names, child PATH, zdotdir, harness and the launch line flag for flag; the program's version against codex_min_version (run only for the program that receipt binds). After every Codex job kyboot.py reads the common git directory's config and hooks again (and, for a job-rooted run, the item working copy's HEAD and status): any change fails the job. There is no turn cap: Codex has no turn limit, so the deadline is the only one.

job_id.description: One safe path component: it names <KY_SCRATCH>/jobs/<job_id> and <KY_RUN>/jobs/<job_id>. Its action ids ACT-launch-<job_id> and ACT-submit-<job_id> must fit the 160 characters of an action id (schemas/action.json); kyboot.py refuses a job id whose action ids would not.

kind.description: The job kind; it sets the turn cap kyboot.py enforces (plan §7): BUILD 150, REWORK 100, VERIFY 60, ARTIFACT 60, PRE-ACCEPT 40, RULING 30, SURROGATE 30 (the owner surrogate's ruling job), PLAN 300.

role.description: The launch configuration's role: it names the qualification receipt <KY_RUN>/QUALIFICATIONS/<role>-<model>.json, which must be PASS, say engine codex and bind this launch. The planner is Claude Code only (kyloop.py fixes its launch line).

codex_min_version.description: The lowest `codex --version` (X.Y.Z; a pre-release suffix is not compared) this launch accepts; the receipt's codex_version must equal the program's whole.

model.description: The OpenAI model of the Codex roster: gpt-6.1-sol for every Codex agent (owner decision 2026-10-12). Another model needs a schema change (reviewed), as a Claude model does.

effort.description: high (xhigh for PLAN, which Codex does not run). Never ultra (sub-agents) nor persistent (persistent mode).

network.description: sandbox_workspace_write.network_access. false for a builder (the launcher pushes for it) and for read-only; a job-rooted run's own choice (the reviewers: false).

work_root.description: Where -C points (default "worktree"). "job": the job_scratch is -C and, with its TMPDIR, all the job may write (/tmp is excluded on every line) (workspace-write, no writable_dirs, --skip-git-repo-check); the item's working copy is read by absolute path, named by item_worktree and in the prompt as a line ITEM_WORKTREE=<item_worktree>, and its HEAD and git status must be the same after the job (cockpit ruling E1: the reviewers).

commit_mode.description: Required of a Codex builder (worktree-rooted, workspace-write), and only there (cockpit ruling E7): "launcher" — the job has no write access to any git directory and no network; it leaves its changes in the working copy and a proposed commit_message in result.json (schemas/job_result_launcher_commit.json); the launcher commits and pushes outside the sandbox.

item_worktree.description: work_root "job" only, and then required: the item's working copy, read by absolute path — the same directory as worktree, which the branch, base and policy checks hold to.

writable_dirs.description: Extra writable roots (--add-dir) besides -C and, for a builder, the job's own folder; empty for read-only and for a job-rooted run. Never a git directory, a path inside one or a folder that holds the worktree's common git directory (derived with git and checked): a Codex job writes no git directory.

env.description: The job's whole environment (env -i semantics). Names and values are checked by kyboot.py against the plan §7 allowlist; JOB_SCRATCH (= job_scratch) and KY_SCRATCH (= the supervisor's resolved campaign scratch folder) are required there. This schema cannot type an open map.

output_schema.description: Optional --output-schema: the JSON schema of the job's final message; a manifest component, hashed. A job with one that leaves no result.json is judged on final_message.txt.
